rules.heading: THE AUSPICIOUS LAGNA OR ASCENDANT FOR THE UPANAYANA MUHURTA

planetary.freeform: Venus, Jupiter, the Moon and the Ascendant Lord are in the 6th and 8th House; Malefic Planets are in the 1st, 8th, and 5th Houses.

exclusions: Venus, Jupiter, Moon, and Ascendant Lord in 6th/8th houses
rules.notes: Venus, Jupiter, Moon, and Ascendant lord should not be in the 6th or 8th house, and malefics in the 1st, 8th, or 5th are inauspicious for upanayana.

rules.heading: THE FAVOURABLE LAGNA OR ASCENDANT IN THE UPANAYANA SAMSKARA

planetary.freeform: Benefics should not be in 6/8/12 houses. Malefics in 3/6/11 houses are auspicious. Full Moon in exaltation or own sign in ascendant is excellent.

rules.notes: Benefics are forbidden in 6/8/12, malefics are auspicious in 3/6/11, and the Full Moon is excellent if in exaltation or own sign in the ascendant.

rules.heading: THE LORDS OF THE VARNAS LIKE BRAHMINS ETC AND OF THE VEDAS

planetary.freeform: Lists planetary lords for varnas (Brahmins: Jupiter, Venus; Kshatriyas: Sun, Mars; Vaishyas: Moon; Shudras: Mercury; Antyajas: Saturn) and Vedas (Rigaveda: Jupiter, Yajurveda: Venus, Saamaveda: Mars, Atharvaveda: Mercury).

rules.notes: Provides the planetary rulers for different social classes (varnas) and Vedas.
